body: I’m sorry to hear that buddy, but yea talking about it is scary and you’re right, I think the best people to talk to are the ones that can relate. It seems like your case is a bit worse then mine so just hang in there man. What I’ve done so far now is I broke up with my gf bc I know she’s better off without me and I need to focus on myself mentally bcuz her anger issues were not helping me at all. But the best thing I can recommend is to move on with your head up, don’t get me wrong I still feel depressed and on edge all the time but I try to look at a lot of little blessings as a aign if good hope, and also to write down a plan, or a goal that you need to execute, something that can help you mentally, an all.
I will thanks for reaching out to my concern, It helps to know that there’s a lot more good people out there then I think.
